# LaverageAI

> Practical AI workshops, training, and implementation for small and medium businesses.

LaverageAI helps teams without a technical background adopt AI through hands-on workshops, workflow implementation, and AI strategy. Sessions are built around the work the team already does, not generic prompting theory.

Founder: Basma Kaanane, approved Anthropic SMB trainer.

## What we do

- AI readiness assessment
- AI workshops for non-technical teams
- Claude and ChatGPT training
- Workflow automation
- Custom AI assistants
- AI strategy
- Implementation
- Ongoing advisory

## Who it is for

Small and medium businesses, founders, and teams that want AI to save time on real work. No prior AI experience is required.
